what: It makes the Oura smart ring and a paid app that turns body data into health insights.
proceeds: Oura expects about $532.6 million in net proceeds. About $526.4 million will cover taxes owed when employee stock units vest at the offering. The rest is for general business needs.
risks: Oura's fast growth may not last, and its growth rate is expected to slow over time.
If Oura cannot attract new members and keep current ones, its business and growth will suffer.
Oura faces strong competition from larger companies with more money, bigger brands and wider sales networks.
Oura has only recently become profitable and may not stay profitable as its costs rise.
If Oura cannot keep launching new and improved products and features, including getting any needed FDA approval, its results may suffer.
